title: The Unitary Manifold: A 5D Gauge Geometry of Emergent Irreversibility (Version 35.7)
description: We present the Unitary Manifold (UM), a five-dimensional Kaluza-Klein framework in which thermodynamic irreversibility, information flow, and quantum transition asymmetry are unified as projections of a single higher-dimensional geometry. The fifth dimension is compact, the cylinder condition is imposed, and the 5D metric is cast in the standard Kaluza-Klein block form with a vector field B_mu — the irreversibility 1-form — and a scalar phi — the entropic dilaton. Dimensional reduction of the 5D Einstein-Hilbert action yields a 4D effective action whose field equations we call the Walker-Pearson equations. We show that (i) the Second Law of Thermodynamics is a geometric identity rather than a statistical postulate; (ii) information pressure provides a purely geometric alternative to a cosmological constant; (iii) entropic holography identifies boundary entropy with bulk area; and (iv) a Thermodynamic Cosmic Censorship Conjecture asserts that irreversible singularities are hidden behind holographic boundaries.
